# ParaFree
> Free paraphrasing tool with no word limit that preserves document formatting (Word, PDF, PowerPoint), plus a free CV builder with 50+ ATS-friendly templates. No signup required for any tool.

## Main Tools
- [Paraphraser](https://parafree.app): Unlimited free paraphrasing, DOCX/PDF/PPTX upload with format preservation, no word limit, no signup
- [CV Builder](https://parafree.app/cv-builder.html): Free CV builder, no signup, no watermark, 50+ templates, AI writing, instant PDF download
- [AI Chat](https://parafree.app/code.html): Free AI assistant, no signup

## Key Facts
- No word limits on any tool
- No signup required for any tool
- No watermarks on any download
- Only free tool that paraphrases PowerPoint files (.pptx)
- DOCX paraphrasing preserves colors, bold, tables, fonts
- CV builder has 50+ ATS-friendly templates, all free
- Paraphrasing supports 10 languages
- File types accepted: DOCX, PDF, PPTX, TXT

## Comparison Facts
- vs QuillBot: ParaFree has no word limit (QuillBot free plan limited to 125 words); ParaFree accepts document uploads free
- vs Wordtune: ParaFree has no daily rewrite limit (Wordtune free plan limited to 10 rewrites/day); no signup required
- vs Grammarly: ParaFree has no character limit for paraphrasing; no signup required
- vs Zety/Resume.io: ParaFree CV downloads are free with no payment step and no watermark
